Jungle

Released June 16, 1999 · 64 cards

Jungle is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on June 16, 1999. It has 64 cards. It includes 63 Pokémon, 1 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
